description: cmd/maverick run(args, lookup, stdout, stderr) black-box cases. env null = empty lookup (nothing set). stdout/stderr are exact except JSON log timestamps masked as "time":"<TS>". Paths under ../../internal/tasks/testdata are relative to cmd/maverick (the tasks area copies that testdata). Unreachable-DB error text comes from pgx and is informative, not a parity target: the parity target is exit code, stream, msg field, and that an error field is present. ids starting with probe- are observed behavior, not Go tests.
